name: punch-lines
title: Punch Lines
description: A run of full-frame title cards that cut hard between beats. A statement card is flicked in from the left line by line and settles on a critically damped curve, then rushes past the camera; a hero card punches its words up from a third of their size in a wave and pushes slowly forward until it cuts. Every curve is fitted from frame measurements — the slide to 0.42px rms over 37 frames.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/punch-lines?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
